title: Improved whitelist
description: Replaces the regular whitelist with a more flexible one.
body:
**This plugin is a replacement for the standard Minecraft whitelist**.
You can configure various notifications in the **plugin's config file**.


**Commands:**

/wl reload - updates the config data without restarting the server

/wl add <name> - allows you to add a player to the whitelist

/wl remove <name> - allows you to remove a player from the whitelist
